prompts.headerIcon:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Nagori macOS application icon and compact app-header logo.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the supplied Nagori brand board.
Primary request: isolate ONLY the large LIGHT app icon in the upper-left area of this board into one production-ready square PNG asset. Preserve its actual artwork: white softly rounded square backing, white paper with folded turquoise/mint upper-right corner, three gray text strokes, and intertwined navy plus mint/cyan ribbon forming N. Preserve the same proportions, rounded corners, shading, palette and silhouette; do not redesign or add details.
Composition: icon centered and large, with about 5% transparent margin on each side, suitable for a macOS Dock icon.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the rounded square. Remove the board background and external floating shadow; retain the icon's own subtle internal depth.
Constraints: one icon only. No wordmark, tagline, labels, extra icons or checkerboard pixels. Faithful extraction of the top-left light icon, not the dark variant.
prompts.appIcon:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Nagori app icon PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target, the supplied brand board.
Isolate ONLY the large DARK rounded-square app icon at the lower-left, which is labelled "App Icon". Preserve the exact original icon artwork and colors: dark slate/navy smooth rounded-square base, white paper with mint/cyan folded corner, three gray horizontal text strokes, navy N ribbon with a cyan/mint wave. Keep the softly dimensional polished appearance.
Center that single icon large on a square canvas with 5% margin. All pixels OUTSIDE the dark rounded-square base must be genuine transparent alpha. Crisp clean smoothly antialiased silhouette, with NO outer shadow, halo or loose specks.
No board background, text, labels, wordmark, dock or extra icons. Faithfully extract the existing lower-left App Icon, no design changes.
prompts.wordmark:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Nagori app header wordmark, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the Nagori brand board.
Primary request: isolate ONLY the large "Nagori" wordmark at the upper-right of the input. Reproduce the provided lettering faithfully, not a substitute typeface. Preserve the exact soft rounded letter silhouettes, lowercase a/g/o/r/i, rounded navy uppercase N, broad letter proportions and spacing, subtle navy shading, and circular mint-to-cyan gradient dot over the i.
Text (verbatim): "Nagori" (N a g o r i).
Composition: a single horizontal wordmark filling the width, centered with small transparent margins. Keep the g descender and i dot complete. Wide canvas with approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, no unnecessary blank space.
Background: real transparent alpha throughout all negative space, including inside both o/a/g counters.
Constraints: remove EVERY other element from the board, including icons, tagline, background glow, drop shadow, labels and decorative graphics. Only the wordmark, no icon. Clean smooth antialiased edges, no white fringe or stray pixels. Preserve typography and original navy/mint colors exactly.
prompts.darkWordmark:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: dark-theme variant of an existing Nagori transparent PNG wordmark.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an already isolated exact "Nagori" wordmark.
Change ONLY the navy lettering's color into pale cool white (#eaf1fb), maintaining a very subtle tonal variation. Keep every contour, letter shape, thickness, spacing, position, size, lowercase g descender and canvas geometry unchanged. Keep the mint/cyan gradient i dot EXACTLY as it is, including its circle shape and position.
Text unchanged verbatim: "Nagori".
Background remains genuine alpha transparency, including holes inside letters. No dark backdrop, no shadow, no white fringe, no extra text or icon. This is a recolor of the same artwork for a dark application header, not a redesign.
prompts.appIconForeground:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Nagori macOS app icon foreground with transparent background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing Nagori icon.
Remove the entire outer dark slate/navy rounded-square tile/backing, its rim, and its shadow. KEEP ONLY the inner paper-and-N artwork: the softly rounded white document, folded mint/cyan upper-right corner, three gray strokes, and intertwined navy ribbon plus mint/cyan wave forming N. The artwork should be faithfully preserved, not redesigned.
Make the retained paper-and-N artwork centered and LARGE: about 88% of a square canvas's height with balanced clear margins. Maintain the artwork's original aspect ratio.
All space outside the PAPER AND N silhouette must be genuine transparent alpha. There must be NO surrounding rounded-square tile, no second square, no dark backdrop, no light backdrop, no ground or scene. Clean smooth antialiased edges, no detached specks or external shadow. A single paper-and-N foreground icon only.
This PNG will be displayed on a macOS-provided icon plate, so do NOT bake any outer app-icon plate into the asset. No text or wordmark.
prompts.appIconWhite:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Nagori macOS app icon PNG with a white background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the transparent paper-and-N foreground artwork.
Change ONLY the transparent background to an opaque clean near-white (#ffffff) background filling the ENTIRE square canvas, all the way to every edge and corner. Preserve the paper/N silhouette, positions, proportions, folded mint/cyan corner, three gray strokes, navy and mint ribbon and their colors exactly.
Keep the paper-and-N centered at the same size. The square background should be uniformly white, with no gray shading, dark gradient, rim, extra inner tile, rounded rectangle or border. Do not introduce a separate rounded-square platform around the artwork. It is a flat white full-bleed square canvas; macOS will mask its outer corners when displaying it.
No external shadow. No labels or wordmark. The goal is ONE white app-icon background with the existing paper-and-N artwork, not a tile placed inside another tile.
